input.change_text: Added `reconnectMcpServer()` and `toggleMcpServer()` methods for managing MCP server connections

output.subject: reconnectMcpServer() and toggleMcpServer() methods
output.action_text: Upgrade to `claude-agent-sdk-typescript` 0.2.21+ to call `reconnectMcpServer(name)` after transient transport drops and `toggleMcpServer(name)` to enable or disable a server mid-session. Replaces restarting the whole `Query` to recover one bad MCP connection.
